item.title: Santa Barbara tensions inspire proposal to weaken jail authority of sheriffs across California
item.description: A newly-proposed state law would let local elected officials across all 58 California counties strip control of jails from sheriffs and shift operations to civilian authority. The post Santa Barbara tensions inspire proposal to weaken jail authority of sheriffs across California appeared first on Santa Barbara News-Press.
